description: This file implements the Migration plugin for WPEFramework, including initialization, deinitialization, and connection management.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Implements the Migration plugin with lifecycle management and connection handling.

methods.name: Migration
methods.description: Constructor, initializes internal members and logs startup.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, sets up migration object, and registers plugin API.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters plugin API, terminates remote connection if any, and releases references.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string (currently empty).

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation, submits deactivation job to worker pool.
